host_controls.scope: Authored managed-host controls using fake session and audio adapters. Aggregate pass is bound to the exact commit and reviewed test sources.

source_pause_seek_review: Frozen native-status position is read after Pause before immediate source resume.
Source resume/seek rechecks event/source/media proof and uses source-rate frame units.
Near-end downsample seek observes actual endpoint-quantized EOF and avoids issuing Play in Finished phase.
Delayed pre-pause and pre-resume status polls cannot overwrite the newer transport epoch.
Malformed managed sample arrays/frame/rate/nonfinite values are rejected before native pointer calls.
